description: A supplied classical native raw derivation of \(A\) from \(\Gamma\), together with supplied intuitionistic raw derivations of every \(B^{\mathsf N}\) for \(B\in\Gamma\) from a specified target context \(\Delta\), gives an actual intuitionistic raw derivation of \(A^{\mathsf N}\) from \(\Delta\), retaining the free names and logical-equality mode.
